entities.summary: Russian novelist (1828-1910) whose War and Peace and Anna Karenina are considered among the greatest works of world literature. Beyond fiction, Tolstoy's philosophical writings on nonviolent resistance, Christian anarchism, and the meaning of life influenced Gandhi, Martin Luther King Jr., and countless social reformers.
